## Summary

[Partial] Remove the original VG33E engine and install a larger V8, such as Ford 4.6L or GM LQ4. [t2278]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. [Partial] Remove the original VG33E engine.
2. Install a larger V8, such as Ford 4.6L or GM LQ4.

_Procedure reported by [t2278]._

## Parts

- Clutch: Required for manual swaps to handle increased engine load and torque. [t2278]
- Engine: Ford 4.6L is compact and SOHC; GM LQ4 offers more power but requires fabrication. [t2278]
- [Partial] Transmission: Ford F-150 transmission is noted for being 'insanely long' and may require fitting into the tunnel. [t2278]

## Tips & gotchas

- Ford 4.6L is preferred by some due to SOHC familiarity from F150s. [t2278]
- GM LQ4 availability might be easier locally than Ford options in some areas. [t2278]
